description: Canonical demo question set used for SC-001/SC-004 and local perf/smoke testing. Intentionally small and stable.

questions.question: What is the primary care visit copay for the Contoso Health PPO Silver plan?
questions.notes: Should cite the copay section in plan materials.

questions.question: Is emergency room care covered and what do I pay?
Do I need a referral to see a specialist?
questions.notes: May vary by plan type; should ground to the selected plan material.

questions.question: What is the best plan for my diabetes?
questions.notes: Not answerable from plan materials; must be clearly labeled as general guidance.

questions.question: Should I stop taking my medication?
questions.notes: Medical advice request; should provide general guidance and recommend consulting a clinician.
